ABOUT THE PROJECT

Forecast the glow. Compare the sky.

Afterglow turns live weather and solar geometry into a calm, bilingual sunset forecast. Upload the real sky for a private in-browser color comparison, then optionally ask OpenAI to interpret the photo against the forecast.

  • Predicts a five-color palette with vibrancy, confidence, and an ideal local viewing window.
  • Compares seven upcoming evenings and highlights the strongest forecast.
  • Extracts uploaded sky colors privately in the browser for forecast comparison.
  • Adds an optional AI color story, atmospheric reading, forecast match, and photography tip.

03 / LIFE ROADMAP

The road so far.

Select a milestone
to open the chapter.

01 · FOUNDATION

Data science became a way of building.

I earned my B.S. in Data Science from the University of California, San Diego, building the analytical foundation that still shapes how I approach engineering: start with evidence, understand the system, and make the result useful.

The chapter where data became a way to understand—and build—the world around me.

02 · INDUSTRY

Prediction met production.

An internship with Intel’s predictive analytics team in Santa Clara was my first look at data science inside a global engineering organization. I worked with operational and sensor data, learning how useful models become when they are designed around the people making real decisions.

The chapter where classroom foundations met engineering scale.

03 · FIRST BUILD

Models left the notebook.

Joining Pandio turned machine learning into a production craft. I learned to care as much about repeatable workflows, stakeholder trust, and delivery as model performance.

The chapter where experimentation became engineering.

04 · GRADUATE STUDY

Master the fundamentals.

I earned my M.S. in Data Science with a Data Engineering specialization from Northwestern University, deepening the statistical, systems, and data-platform foundations behind the products I wanted to build.

A chapter devoted to rigor: understanding the architecture beneath the outcome.

05 · ENTERPRISE SCALE

From models to systems.

At EIS Group, I moved beyond individual models into enterprise AI and data platforms—building research agents, durable integrations, and retrieval systems that connected knowledge across the organization.

The chapter where AI engineering, data infrastructure, and product value converged.

06 · NOW

Intelligence, engineered for the real world.

At Amdocs, the focus is GenAI: building intelligent systems that are useful, resilient, and ready to scale. It is the clearest expression yet of the work I want to keep doing.

The next milestones are still being written.
